criteria.criterion: Final legal Stage3 R@10 and continuing loop
criteria.verbatim: 这是持续迭代的研究 Issue，不是一次实验交付 Issue。继承 #255 的三曲率分层门控与累计截面曲率监督框架；#255 当前仍在执行，先等待其真实最终结果并审计，再作为本 Issue 的起点，不并行重复执行其模型。每轮完成后必须基于实际证据定位未达到目标的原因，提出针对性的下一轮修改，验证并迭代，直到同一冻结推荐协议下合法、完整 Stage3 最终 test R@10 > 0.065（严格沿用仓库采纳阈值）。没有达到目标不得标 COMPLETED 或以负结果结束本 Issue；真实权限/资源/外部依赖阻塞如实记录，等待解决，不伪造、不绕过权限。达到阈值后仍须完成完整验收、复算、归档和来源绑定才允许关闭。

criteria.threshold: test_R@10 > 0.065; do not complete after a failed candidate
criteria.observed: PASS: #255 is CLOSED as BLOCKED with pushed evidence and the #256 loop continued from the audited R03 negative result (test_R@10 0.0490085133794112). R04 read the frozen final test once, after the mechanism signature and the round decision were frozen, and the loop continues because the closure threshold is still not met.

The R04 change moves the role table from the level-1 cost to the level-3 cost; no mechanism component was replaced.

The R03 export measured the item-unique information in H(L3|L1L2)=1.9028 bits over 23248 triples of 24587 items, with level 1 already near-uniform (7.4596 of 8 bits); the R03 level-1 change had left the triple unchanged, so R04 moved the coupling to the level that carries the freedom (rounds/r04/DIAGNOSIS.json).
